as_told.title: Bigelow worked with Harry Reid to reverse-engineer UFOs

related.note: The same $22 million Reid-funded program run through Bigelow Aerospace. The telling's core claim is new: Colonel Alexander set it up and steered it toward a fixed end, which the story's tellings do not say.

plain: Around 2008, the claim goes, $22 million of government money went to Bigelow Aerospace, a company owned by the businessman Robert Bigelow, to research UFOs, with the help of Senator Harry Reid. A guest named Steven Greer tells Michels that a retired Army colonel named John B. Alexander, whom he calls Bigelow's "consigliere", was behind how the whole arrangement was set up. Michels tells it himself without the money or Alexander: Bigelow, he says, worked with Reid, then the Senate Majority Leader, "in an official government capacity" to reverse engineer UFOs, meaning to take apart recovered craft to learn how they work. If true, it would mean a private company was doing the government's UFO research with public money.
